The best vegan restaurant in Vietnam
Apr 2024 • Couples
This place is the best. Super cute atmosphere, the guys who runs it is a character in the best way. We spent 2 nights in Saigon and had dinner here both nights. After spending 2 weeks in the north eating veggie rice, noodles and tofu with tomato sauce it was much needed to have some western styled food. The fish n chips were amazing and so were all the desserts we tried a must go for vegans and the price is super affordable so even tho they are definitely appealing to western travelers the price are local which was not the case with some other restaurants catering to westerns we saw

Amazing find in district 1
Mar 2024 • Solo
Amazing ‘junk food’ vegan cafe in the heart of district 1
Run by a really lovely bloke originally from south london been here 18 years
Food was just what I needed!
Hadn’t had a cheese toasty in years and his cashew cheese and onion toastie with real chips really hit the spot!
The Oreo cheesecake was lush and a generous portion too!
All this and a coke for 200k
It’s on a busy street and is on the first floor so I walked past it first
Pros: Great host , Lovely chips , Amazing ’cheeze’ replacements
